subject: FIX in decode client: START size fields order (opus-hevcdec)
body: In dec1/vdec_ref.c the DEC START message has its two size fields swapped: the kernel sends bitstream LENGTH first and buffer SIZE second (vdec_common_if.c:267-268). H.264 tolerates it, HEVC does not (stale bytes re-decoded, extra output buffer requested). Fix in DEC01's n2ap_vdec.c and DEC05's service; also re-send the same frame when the decoder answers 'need more output buffer'. See fakevdec_hevc/vdec_hevc_ref.c for the corrected driver.
